title: Qualified baselines and continuation policy
summary: Wire UI Swing v0.2-dev12 is the current source-qualified presentation continuation. It preserves dev10's fully qualified Server v0.17 / Builder v0.11 / RangeRequested / workspace-context semantics, retains dev11 projected lifecycle/status presentation, adds renderer-only secondary document metadata plus clearer navigation selection, and repairs the interactive --notnotes-demo launcher routing found during visual acceptance.
invariants: Continue from packages/wire_ui_swing_v0.2-dev12; historical dev3/dev5/dev6/dev10/dev11 remain lineage evidence.
Dev12 document secondary metadata is presentation only: projected type/owner/meta/subtitle may be shown, but must not widen semantic action detail.
Navigation selection styling is local presentation state and must not emit application actions.
Retain dev10 semantic qualification for Server v0.17 flat window metadata, bounded RangeRequested, workspaceContext, real ooRexx/BSF and Builder v0.11 integration.
Executable qualification must cover generic --smoke-window, --notnotes-smoke, interactive --notnotes-demo routing and exact no-argument product launch.
Keep generic Java/Swing rules in the java sphere; keep Wire-specific renderer/protocol/qualification knowledge in this sphere.
procedure: Start from packages/wire_ui_swing_v0.2-dev12 on the wire-ui-swing-dev12 GitHub branch until merged to main.
Preserve stable semantic identities and the existing event-time UI_ACTION boundary.
Treat document metadata hierarchy, navigation highlighting and material/style-role changes as renderer presentation only.
Run strict Java and the complete renderer suite; capture a real desktop for presentation changes.
If semantic/protocol code changes, rerun Server v0.17, Builder v0.11 and ooRexx/BSF integration before sealing.
Update this sphere and exact continuity records when a successor becomes qualified.
